title: snapshot: items and runs parts carry the fields that list and relay-run list give
lead: *Proposed.* Filed 2026-11-11 from the ork relay session, with the ork owner's permission to write this item into slicer's store; left uncommitted for the owner. A dashboard can read every project in one `slicer snapshot` call only if the snapshot's parts hold the same fields as the per-project commands. Today the items and runs parts are reduced shapes, so ork keeps one `slicer list` and one `slicer relay-run list` process per project per poll.
findings_note: ork owner 2026-11-11: ork's batched polling (ork S335) is held until slicer's snapshot carries the fields its dashboard reads from `slicer list --json --lean` and `slicer relay-run list --json`.
boundary: **Not in this slice:** the `status`, `health` and `deps` values; the `held` and `blocked` booleans on item rows (they go; `status.blocked` and `status.held` still give the ids); s457's fingerprint, `INPUTS` and lazy load; ended runs in the runs part; a `--full` flag or new part names; any list filter or `--envelope` in a snapshot; changing what `relay-run list`, `list` or `goals` print.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
*Proposed.* Read on 2026-11-11 by ork's S335 spec check (`slicer snapshot --json --root . --parts items,runs,goals` on the ork repo):

- Items: the snapshot gives `id, short_title, status, claim, pass, release_target, wave, size, effort, score, quadrant, held, blocked`. ork's item type (ork `internal/slicercli/types.go:85`) also reads `title`, `has_slice`, `depends_on`, `notes`, and `fields` as an object, which `slicer list --json --lean` gives.
- Runs: steps carry only `id, role, phase, task, model, waiting_on, question`, and runs have no `begun_at`, `counts` or `outcome`. ork's run detail reads each step's vendor, reasoning effort and start time (ork `internal/tui/rolefacts.go:70-73`).
- Goals: `records` is a flat list with `kind`; `slicer goals --json` gives `goal` and `non_goal` lists (ork `internal/slicercli/types.go:137`).
- ork's owner chose to wait for this rather than probe revisions and re-read changed parts per project (ork adj 305, `poll.snapshot-gap` = wait-for-slicer).

Open owner questions (the owner answers before the relay starts):
- Q1 the shape. (a) the items part's value is exactly what `slicer list --json --lean` gives for that root, the runs part's value is exactly what `slicer relay-run list --json` gives, and goals matches `slicer goals --json`, so a caller can decode either with one type (recommended). (b) add the missing fields to today's reduced shapes. (c) a `--full` flag that switches parts to (a), keeping today's shape as the default.
- Q2 compatibility. (a) bump the snapshot's schema version and note the change in CHANGELOG.md (recommended). (b) keep the reduced shapes under their current names and add the full ones under new part names.

Owner decisions (2026-11-12): Q3 (b): the runs part's value is exactly `slicer relay-run list --json --active` for that root (today's part also keeps only active runs, `snapshot.py:76`), not every run in the ledger.

Read on main at 6df034ca; s457 lands first and rewrites `snapshot.build` and `cmd_snapshot` (lazy load, `INPUTS`, a `fingerprint` key per part), so every line number here is re-found after s457. This slice changes no fingerprint logic, no `INPUTS` entry and no part key order.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `src/slicer/snapshot.py`: the `items`, `goals` and `runs` readers in `build` (`:42-76` today) each become one `read(...)` call, with no reshaping and no second copy of a command's shape; `SCHEMA = 2`; drop imports left unused (`graph`, `queries`, `relayrun`).
- `src/slicer/cli_report.py` `cmd_snapshot` (`:186-252`): `read` (`:237-242`) takes an argv tuple (e.g. `read("list", "--lean")`, `read("relay-run", "list", "--active")`) and adds `--json`; it sets `sub.root = str(root)` so `_run_root` does not discover from the cwd (`cli_relay.py:218-219`), and sets `sub._state` only for handlers that load state, so the runs read never forces s457's lazy load; the literal `"snapshot": 1` (`:250`) becomes `snapshot.SCHEMA`.
- `src/slicer/cli_relay.py` `_emit_run` (`:222-227`): when `args._collect` is set, append the payload as `_emit` does and do not print (today `relay-run list` cannot be captured).
- `tests/test_snapshot.py`: new tests; update `:38-62` (version 1, flat goals `records`), `:65-106` (reduced item rows), `:138` (goals shape), `:236-257` (`runs[0]` becomes `runs["runs"][0]`); `test_Snapshot_Runs_OnlyActive` (`:218`) becomes the equality test below.
- `docs/agents.md:728-812` (JSON example: `"snapshot": 2`, runs value `{"runs": []}`, goals `{"goal": [], "non_goal": []}`; the items, goals and runs bullets; one line on version 2), `docs/commands.md:101`.
- `landed-changed/s459.md` only through `slicer changelog add`.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
In `tests/test_snapshot.py`, class `SnapshotTests`:

- `test_Snapshot_ItemsPart_EqualsListJsonLean`: a fixture with a dependency, a hold flag, a note, a done item and a set field; `parts.items.value == json.loads(list --json --lean)` and revision `== snapshot.revision(value)`. Fails first: reduced rows lack `title`, `notes`, `depends_on`, `fields`.
- `test_Snapshot_RunsPart_EqualsRelayRunListActiveJson`: one ended and one active run whose step has `--vendor` and `--reasoning`; `value == json.loads(relay-run list --json --active)`, an object with `runs` holding the active run only, with its `begun_at`, `counts` and step vendor and reasoning. Fails first: the value is a list with reduced steps.
- `test_Snapshot_GoalsPart_EqualsGoalsJson`: prose plus goal, non-goal and retired records; `value == json.loads(goals --json)`. Fails first: flat `records` with `kind`.
- `test_Snapshot_SchemaVersion_IsTwo`: `data["snapshot"] == 2 == snapshot_module.SCHEMA`. Fails first: version 1, no `SCHEMA`.
- `test_Snapshot_Since_FullValues_UnchangedThenChanged`: a `--since` reply gives `unchanged` for items, runs and goals; a note added to S01 changes the items revision and the new value carries it; `relay-run end` changes the runs revision. Fails first: notes are not in today's items value.
- `test_Snapshot_RunsPart_OtherRoot_ReadsThatRootsLedger`: from project A's cwd with `--root B`, runs equals B's `relay-run list --json --active`. Guard: passes before; red if `read` stops setting `sub.root`.
- `test_Snapshot_SnapshotLean_DoesNotChangePartValues`: part values under `snapshot --json --lean` equal those under `--json`. Guard.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Tests first; update the existing assertions listed under Files; confirm each new test fails for the reason given.
2. `_emit_run`: the `_collect` branch; `relay-run list` output unchanged.
3. `read` in `cmd_snapshot`: argv tuple, `sub.root` set, `_state` only where the handler uses it; compatible with s457's lazy state.
4. `build`: `items` is `read("list", "--lean")` (default filters, no `--envelope`); `goals` is `read("goals")`; `runs` is `read("relay-run", "list", "--active")`; `status`, `health`, `deps` unchanged; s457's fingerprint, `INPUTS` and the always-built `runs` untouched.
5. `SCHEMA = 2`, used in `cmd_snapshot`.
6. Docs; `slicer changelog add s459 --category Changed` naming the version bump and the new item, run and goal shapes.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t tests -k SnapshotTests` passes.
- `python3 tests/affected.py --run`, then `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t tests` pass.
- Mutation: drop `--lean` from the items read and `test_Snapshot_ItemsPart_EqualsListJsonLean` goes red; drop `--active` and `test_Snapshot_RunsPart_EqualsRelayRunListActiveJson` goes red; drop `sub.root` and `test_Snapshot_RunsPart_OtherRoot_ReadsThatRootsLedger` goes red.
- Orchestrator runs: `PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m slicer check` exits 0.
- Orchestrator runs: `PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m slicer snapshot --json --parts items,runs,goals` on this repo; each value equals `... list --json --lean`, `... relay-run list --json --active` and `... goals --json`.
